split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases are sibling-industry boundaries (N1 web designer = design/marketing-agency territory, N2 AI/ML = data_ai_consulting industry) and indirect intent (P7 'technical partner'). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining sub-services and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.

we need a mobile app developer to ship our iOS app in Q1
looking for a DevOps consultancy to migrate us from on-prem to AWS
we need a technical partner to build out our internal tooling, Northeast preferred
queries.notes: HARD: indirect — 'technical partner' not 'developer/firm/agency'. Tests indirect-intent triggering.
